title: Label templates
summary: Design and manage the label templates used when printing.

steps.text: Open {lbl} from Inventory Settings to see the {tmpl} list.
Choose {add} to create a new template, then lay out its fields in the editor.
Click a template to edit it: its name, its size in millimetres and where each field sits on the label.
You can also ask the assistant to list, add, change or delete label templates. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
